mcp_tools.name: codebase_visualization
mcp_tools.title: Codebase visualization
mcp_tools.description: Submits a codebase-visualization artifact manifest (declared diagram entries, dependency view and module counts, call and flow views, architecture map and declared C4 levels, metrics and history views, honesty and currency record) and returns a deterministic CODEBASE_VISUALIZATION_READY / CODEBASE_VISUALIZATION_NOT_READY / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed diagram-entry completeness, dependency-coverage, C4-coverage and hotspot-score checks, with per-check evidence. Validates the declared record; it renders nothing and reads no code.

inputSchema.description: The codebase-visualization artifact manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table).

expect.notes: All 32 checks pass: 1 complete diagram entry (mermaid), dependency 10/10, C4 levels context/containers/components, hotspot 5.0 x 2.0 = 10.0 declared 10.0. [Tester correction: designer carried computed quantities only in prose notes; added structured computed_spot_checks.]
